contentText:
Rebecca Bellan / TechCrunch :

A profile of AI video generation startup Runway, which is training models directly on observational data, is now valued at $5.3B, and added $40M in ARR in Q2   —  Every major AI lab is betting on language.  Runway is betting they're wrong.  —  AI video generation startup Runway doesn't have the typical Silicon Valley pedigree.
